newsitem.title: USA: HEARx gets hearing care contract from GHI.
newsitem.headline: HEARx gets hearing care contract from GHI.

text.p: HEARx Ltd said Thursday that GHI, the largest not for profit health services company operating statewide in New York, has awarded HEARx a contract for hearing care services to be part of certain future GHI product offerings.
The company said all potential eligible members will be able to avail themselves of the hearing aid benefit or diagnostic audiology services in any HEARx center in the Northeast or in Florida.
HEARx said its program of standardizing all centers means that all services can be provided througout the HEARx network without any difference in the cost to the consumer or the health care provider.
